recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any future MedicationKnowledge, FormularyItem, or IDMP alignment work after the 2025 MedicationKnowledge removal should be raised as a new work-group decision rather than applied retroactively to FHIR-13392.
issue_request: FHIR-13392 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Pharmacy change request asking to enhance Medication package and ingredient areas for alignment with the IDMP Authorized Medicinal Product model.
initial_application: No source commit was found that directly applied FHIR-13392 by key. The relevant history shows the PSS path was pursued through a draft MedicationKnowledge resource added in 2018, and a related Medication package/product issue later recorded that similar requirements no longer related to Medication and were incorporated into MedicationKnowledge.
additional_context: Medication remains active in the current build. MedicationKnowledge was removed from the active resource list in 2025, while active medication-definition resources such as MedicinalProductDefinition, PackagedProductDefinition, ManufacturedItemDefinition, AdministrableProductDefinition, RegulatedAuthorization, Ingredient, and SubstanceDefinition now cover detailed product, package, pharmaceutical product, and ingredient modeling.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Adding new IDMP-specific Medication enhancements under this old tracker would contradict the recorded supersession, duplicate the separate medication-definition model, and reopen a later Pharmacy/BR&R scope decision.
